parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true and reside in the same test file 'Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift' within the Playlist package. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) is expected because both methods are testing related but distinct behaviours of the same API-version resolution logic — one verifies the default V1 path when no override or flag is present (line 28), the other verifies fallback behaviour when an invalid feature flag is supplied (line 108). Collapsing them would obscure the separate failure modes each test is designed to catch, reducing test clarity and diagnostic value.
